items.title: Seasonal reorganization of hippocampal place fields in wild bats
items.hook: Wild bats redraw their mental maps when the seasons change
items.summary: Researchers recorded neurons in the hippocampus of bats flying outdoors over a full year. The cells that mark locations shifted their preferred spots between summer and winter, tracking where food was found.

items.title: A sharper bound for the sunflower problem over finite fields
items.hook: Mathematicians tighten a decades-old limit on overlapping sets
items.summary: The sunflower problem asks how many sets you can collect before some of them must overlap in a perfectly regular way. This paper proves a smaller upper bound for the version over finite fields.
